verdict.rationale: gstack is a skill and tool pack for AI coding agents, so outbound event webhooks are a fair axis for this kind of product. The evidence covers planning, review, QA, ship and browser skills plus cross-session learnings, but nothing documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks for events. The changelog note on terminal-driven checks reacting to new output is an internal behavior, not a webhook subscription.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
